annotations.title: Delete the person's account for good (typed confirmation)

description: Deletes the signed-in person's account and cannot be undone. Ask the person first and pass `confirm` = the account's e-mail exactly as they type it; without it nothing happens (validation, confirmation_required). In order: every session is revoked; every row of the account is deleted or anonymised in one transaction (favourites, lists and share links, comparisons, price watches including watches set without an account from the same e-mail, energy watches, reviews, devices, every queued or sent mail; error reports, page notices and the audit trail keep their text without the person); the sign-in itself is deleted; one last notice goes to the address. Answers deleted, scope, counts per table, notice and `what` (deleted / anonymised / kept). The token stops working.

confirm.description: The account's e-mail, typed by the person as confirmation.
